description: Email deliverability of ONE campaign (nev-api, the "Entregabilidad" tab of the campaign). view=summary (default): sent, delivered, soft bounces, hard bounces and complaints, plus a warning when something is off. view=bounce_reasons: why messages bounced, grouped by SES bounce subtype; needs bounce_type=soft|hard (call it once per family). view=segment_breakdown: delivery, soft and hard bounces per segment; empty when the campaign targeted a single segment or has no segment attribution. Use it after a send when nevent_get_campaign_metrics shows a high bounce rate, to learn whether the cause is invalid addresses (hard) or mailbox/transient problems (soft). Email campaigns only. For tenant-wide sender health use nevent_get_sending_profile and nevent_get_suppressions_summary instead; for the people behind the bounces use nevent_list_campaign_recipients(status=BOUNCES). Requires ADMIN, OWNER or SUPERADMIN.

bounce_type.description: Required when view=bounce_reasons: the bounce family, soft or hard.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID. Get it from nevent_list_campaigns.

view.description: summary (default): sent, delivered, soft/hard bounces, complaints and an optional warning. bounce_reasons: bounce reasons grouped by SES bounce subtype; needs bounce_type. segment_breakdown: delivery / soft / hard bounce per segment (empty when the campaign has a single segment or no attribution).

name: nevent_get_campaign_deliverability
